# Helix Delivery Group — Project Demand (Live Demo)

Public portfolio demo of a Google Apps Script (GAS) resourcing dashboard: planned-vs-tracked
demand, capacity headroom, billing-signal classification, and evidence-of-work drill-downs.

**"Helix Delivery Group" is a fictional company.** All data shown is synthetic, generated by a
seeder script into a single demo Google Sheet workbook — no real client, employee, or project
names appear anywhere in this folder.

- **Files:** `Code.js` (server), `Dashboard.html` (client), `Security.js` (open-access demo build).
- **Deploy:** same three-file Apps Script setup as the source app — create a project, paste
  `Code`/`Security`/`Dashboard` (HTML file must be named `Dashboard`), then deploy as a web app
  with **Anyone with the link** access. `CONFIG.SOURCE_SS_ID` and `CONFIG.ROSTER_SS_ID` already
  point at the committed synthetic demo workbook.
- **Reseed:** to refresh the demo data, run `buildDemoWorkbook()` to regenerate the workbook,
  repoint `CONFIG.SOURCE_SS_ID` / `CONFIG.ROSTER_SS_ID` at the new sheet ID, then run
  `bustDemandCache_()` so the next load picks it up.
- **Access:** `Security.js` here is a rewritten open-access build (`SEC_PD.OPEN_ACCESS_DEFAULT =
  true`) — there is no email allowlist, unlike the production app.

The production source lives in a private repository and is never deployed publicly — this
folder is a sanitized, standalone copy maintained separately.
